label: EEF1G-dominated single-gene factor
evidence: EEF1G alone is 75% of the weight (spec 1.00) with effective gene number 5 and 15% usage share; the remaining genes are low-weight housekeeping genes (EIF3C, PABPC4, HADHA) with no lineage markers.

label: H19-dominated single-gene factor
evidence: H19 is 77% of the weight (spec 1.00), effective gene number 6; the next genes (KLK6 0.50, MEST 0.30, PGM1 0.38) are minor and mostly low-specificity, with no EPCAM, PAX8 or stromal markers.

label: Cancer-associated fibroblasts
evidence: Highly specific fibroblast/CAF genes: LUM 0.98, DCN 0.81, COL5A1/COL5A2, CTHRC1, FAP, INHBA, COL11A1, THBS2, CDH11, PDGFRA 0.81, LOXL1. Smooth-muscle (MYH11, CNN1) and pericyte genes are in other factors.

label: CD47-high tumor epithelium
evidence: CD47 is 43% of the weight (spec 0.97), plus epithelial genes EPCAM (3.5%, spec 0.58, its top factor), ST14, CLDN7, MSI1, FGFR4 and lipogenic genes FASN, ACACA; PAX8, MUC16, WT1 and CDH1 have zero weight, so it is epithelial but not the canonical PAX8+ program.

label: Smooth muscle cells
evidence: MYH11 (28%, spec 1.00), CNN1 (spec 1.00), SYNPO2, PLN, SYNM, SMTN, MYLK, KCNMB1, LDB3, JPH2, CACNA1H are specific contractile smooth-muscle genes; fibroblast genes (DCN 0.02) are low.

label: C7+ adventitial fibroblasts
evidence: C7 (30%, spec 1.00) with specific ABCA10, ABCA8, TNXB, PAMR1, DPT, PI16, FAIM2, SRPX, plus shared DCN, PDGFRA, CXCL12: the PI16+/C7+ adventitial-type fibroblast profile, distinct from the COL11A1/FAP CAF factor 2.

label: PLXNB1-dominated factor
evidence: PLXNB1 is 47% of the weight (spec 1.00) with minor RGL3, PTPN13, EPOR, MAPK15; some axonemal genes (DNAH5, DNAH7, CFAP47) are moderately specific but FOXJ1 has zero weight and EPCAM/CDH1/PAX8 are absent, so no clear lineage.

label: TIMP3/SFRP4/COMP fibroblasts
evidence: TIMP3 dominates (57%, spec 1.00) with specific SFRP4 (spec 1.00), COMP (spec 1.00), LRRC15, SFRP5, APCDD1 and some COL10A1/MMP11; this matches a COMP+/SFRP4+ CAF flavor, but one gene carries most weight and canonical fibroblast genes (DCN, LUM, COL5A1) are absent.

label: SND1/RARA/DDX10-high
evidence: Many unrelated genes have spec ~1.00 at high weight (SND1 12%, RARA 8.7%, DDX10, RB1, STAT2, PIBF1, URB1, DOCK9, SGSH, APC); they share no pathway or chromosomal region and no lineage markers are present, consistent with a probe/batch artifact or sample-specific signal.

label: Hypoxia response
evidence: Canonical HIF targets with high specificity: NDRG1 1.00, VEGFA 0.98, SLC2A1 1.00, BNIP3 0.99, PDK1 0.88, HK2 0.82, P4HA1, ALDOA, NMB, ENO2, EGLN1, LDHA, PGK1.

label: ADAMTS1-dominated factor
evidence: ADAMTS1 is 56% of the weight (spec 1.00), effective gene number 14; remaining genes (TGFBR2, LAMC1, LRP6, ADAMTS5, EREG) are low-weight and mostly low-specificity, without endothelial (PECAM1) or fibroblast (DCN, LUM) markers.

label: T cell markers
evidence: Specific T/NK genes: TRAC, TRBC1, CD3D/E/G, CD2, CD8A, CD247, LCK, ZAP70, IL7R, CD96, GZMA/H/K/B, PRF1, CTLA4, FOXP3, KLRK1; B/plasma (MS4A1, CD79A, MZB1) and mast (KIT) genes are also here at low weight, so it is a general lymphocyte factor led by T cells.

label: Macrophages
evidence: Specific myeloid/macrophage genes: C1QC, AIF1, MS4A6A, CD14, FCGR2A, MSR1, CD68, CD163, MRC1, CSF1R, CX3CR1, TREM2, VSIG4, F13A1, CYBB. DC markers CLEC9A (0.22) and CD1C (0.49) are weak.

label: H3F3B-dominated single-gene factor
evidence: H3F3B is 93% of the weight (spec 1.00), effective gene number 2; nothing else has substantial weight.

label: Pericytes
evidence: Specific pericyte genes: HEYL 1.00, AVPR1A 1.00, KCNJ8 0.97, RGS5 0.78, PDGFRB, NOTCH3, CSPG4, ABCC9, ENPEP, CCDC102B, GJC1, COL4A1/2; MYH11/CNN1 (smooth muscle) and PECAM1 (endothelium) are in other factors.

label: LAPTM4B-dominated factor
evidence: LAPTM4B is 40% of the weight (spec 1.00) with DNAJC10 and MXRA7 moderately specific; other genes are low-specificity and there are no lineage markers (EPCAM, PAX8 absent).

label: Inflammatory epithelial response (LCN2/CFB)
evidence: LCN2 (29%, spec 1.00) with CFB 0.94, SDC4, ICAM1, CXCL5 1.00, CXCL6 0.97, SAA4 1.00, PSTPIP2, ZC3H12A, KLK10 and NF-kB genes (BIRC3, TNIP1, BCL3, RELB); classic IFN genes and neutrophil markers are not here.

label: Cell cycle S phase
evidence: Specific S-phase/replication genes: MYBL2, TYMS, TK1, RRM2, BRCA1, BRIP1, RAD54L, EXO1, FANCI, CDC25A, ASF1B, UHRF1, CDC6, ORC6, PCNA, MCM2/4, E2F1.

label: POSTN-high fibroblasts
evidence: POSTN is 56% of the weight (spec 1.00) with COL5A1, ADAMTS12, ADAM12, ASPN, TNC, SLIT2, GREM1, CCL11; dominated by one gene but secondary genes are fibroblast ECM genes.

label: Cell cycle G2/M
evidence: Specific G2/M genes: TOP2A, CENPF, UBE2C, CCNB1/2, CDC20, AURKA, ASPM, CENPA, NEK2, KIF20A, PLK1, HMMR, CDKN3, PTTG1, MKI67.

label: SLC40A1-high epithelial subclone
evidence: SLC40A1 (12%, spec 1.00) with many specific epithelial-type genes AVPI1, TNS4, CGNL1, MAOA, LDLR, FOSL1, FGFR3, NECTIN1, AGR2, GABRP, CYP3A5, PAX2 0.97; PAX8, EPCAM, CDH1 and mesothelial markers (UPK3B, CALB2, MSLN) are absent, so it looks like a distinct tumor-cell population rather than a canonical lineage.

label: PKM-dominated single-gene factor
evidence: PKM is 72% of the weight (spec 1.00), effective gene number 5; other glycolytic genes (PGK1 0.34, PFKP 0.18) are minor and low-specificity, unlike the hypoxia factor 9.

label: HNRNPD-dominated single-gene factor
evidence: HNRNPD is 46% of the weight (spec 0.98) with IRAK1 8%; remaining genes are generic nuclear/RNA-processing genes with low specificity and no lineage markers.

label: Interferon response
evidence: Specific ISGs: MX1, IFIT1/2/3, IFI44L, SAMD9, DDX58, IFIH1, HERC6, OAS1/3, CXCL10, CXCL11, RSAD2, plus STAT1, GBP1, IFI35.

label: APP-dominated single-gene factor
evidence: APP is 61% of the weight (spec 1.00), effective gene number 9; the rest are low-specificity secretory/membrane genes (GANAB, CANX, LAMC1).

label: Invasive / partial-EMT tumor epithelium
evidence: TFPI2 (spec 1.00), ANXA3 1.00, TGM2 0.96, LAMC2 0.97, ITGA3, ITGB6, LAMA3, CLDN1, PTX3, CCND1, CDKN2B, MET, TNFRSF12A: a migratory/partial-EMT epithelial program; fibroblast markers are absent.

label: MMP14/MICAL2/HAS2-high stroma
evidence: MMP14 (8%), MICAL2 1.00, HAS2 1.00, SPHK1 0.88, TDO2, MSC, HS3ST3A1, ADAMTS14, VDR with many low-specificity genes (effective 211); canonical fibroblast (DCN, LUM, PDGFRA, COL5A1, FAP) and epithelial (EPCAM, CDH1, PAX8) markers all have zero weight, so lineage is unclear.

label: UCHL1/CDKN2A-high tumor cells
evidence: UCHL1 (11%, spec 1.00) with CDKN2A (spec 0.55, its top factor), NQO1, GCLM, TXNRD1, proteasome subunits and MCM2 at moderate specificity; no neuronal markers and no lineage markers beyond weak tumor-associated genes, suggesting a tumor subclone.

label: ATP5F1A/DAP3-high
evidence: ATP5F1A (16%, spec 0.94), GNAI2, KIF5B, DAP3 1.00, PIH1D1 1.00, AKT1, BECN1, DDX21: general housekeeping genes without a coherent pathway or lineage.

label: Background / non-specific probe signal
evidence: SOX2-OT (15%) plus hundreds of genes (effective 646) not expected in this tissue with spec ~1.00 at tiny weights: DUX4, LPA, HNF4A, DEFA1, GYPB, PCA3, CYP17A1, NR5A1, TDGF1, ADRB1 — a collection of rarely-detected probes typical of background noise.

label: Diffuse housekeeping (YWHAZ/ARF6)
evidence: Diffuse factor (effective 219) of low-specificity housekeeping genes (YWHAZ 0.17, ARF6, NIPSNAP1, TOP2B, ZFAND5); only DOK5 (0.79) and ZCCHC3 (0.62) are specific, and no lineage markers.

label: SULF1/TSPAN3/MYH10-high
evidence: SULF1 (19%, spec 0.74), TSPAN3, MYH10 0.99, CLSTN3 1.00, TRAF4, EPHB2, CDH2, PNOC; fibroblast (DCN, COL5A1), epithelial (EPCAM, CDH1) and neural (SOX10, SOX2) markers have zero weight, so no clear lineage.

label: ESR1/PVT1-high tumor clone
evidence: ESR1, PVT1, PABPC1L and UQCC1 all spec 1.00 at high weight, with several 20q genes (ASXL1, PLCG1, UQCC1, PABPC1L) and 8q24 (PVT1, PTK2, JRK), consistent with a tumor clone (possibly copy-number driven); PGR is not here.

label: NOTCH2NLA-high
evidence: NOTCH2NLA (15%, spec 1.00) with many unrelated specific genes (PI4KA 0.96, PDPK1 1.00, FOXJ2 1.00, ASCC3, BRAF, VWA8, EIF4ENIF1); no pathway or lineage theme, consistent with a clone- or probe-batch-specific signal.

label: Ovarian-type stroma (OSR2/BNC2)
evidence: Specific OSR2 0.84, BNC2 0.72, HOXA5, EFS, PKD2 0.90, FGF2, GHR, TNFSF12, GPRASP1/2, NAP1L3/5, TBX3 and PGR (spec 0.50, low weight), FOXL2 weak; DCN, LUM, PDGFRA, PDGFRB are zero and steroidogenic genes (STAR, CYP17A1) are absent.

label: SNHG15/UGT2B7-high
evidence: SNHG15 (13%, spec 0.86) with unrelated specific genes UGT2B7 0.97, PTH2R 1.00, CRIPT 0.92, YJEFN3 1.00, OVOL2 1.00, PNPLA3 1.00, TEC; no lineage markers (EPCAM, PAX8 zero), so likely clone-specific or artifact.

label: NORAD-dominated single-gene factor
evidence: NORAD is 80% of the weight (spec 1.00), effective gene number 3; nothing else is substantial.

label: HNRNPA1L2-dominated single-gene factor
evidence: HNRNPA1L2 is 75% of the weight (spec 1.00), effective gene number 4; other genes are minor and low-specificity.

label: HNRNPM/ILF3/RAF1-high
evidence: Several unrelated genes each with spec 1.00 at high weight (HNRNPM 18%, ILF3 10%, RAF1, WDR77, ANAPC1, UPF1, PSPC1, NPAT, PANK2, AGO1) and no lineage markers, a pattern suggesting a probe/batch artifact or clone-specific signal.

label: NAMPT/CXCL2/PTGS2 inflammatory response
evidence: NAMPT (56%, spec 1.00) dominates, with CXCL2 0.77, PTGS2 1.00, PLIN2, KLF4, ADM, KDM6B, IFRD1, NFKB1/2; neutrophil markers (FCGR3B, CSF3R, CXCR2) are not here, so it is an inflammatory/stress program dominated by one gene.

label: Immediate early / CCN1-CCN2 response
evidence: CCN1 (38%, spec 1.00), CCN2 0.89, PIM1, SERPINE1, LIF, NR4A1, EGR2, SRF, ATF3, SGK1: an immediate-early/serum-response signature.

label: CP-high tumor epithelium
evidence: CP (24%, spec 1.00) with epithelial genes CDH1 0.46 (one of its top two factors), CLDN7, DSG2, BCAM, SCNN1A, ERBB3, TFAP2A, MSLN 0.28, LY75; PAX8, MUC16 and mesothelial markers (UPK3B, CALB2) are absent.

label: KPNB1/CCT8/CD200-high
evidence: KPNB1 1.00, KHDRBS1 0.95, CCT8 0.81, CD200 0.76, HCFC1 1.00, RRP15 1.00, FAM53C, EMC4, MTRES1 are specific but form no clear pathway; no lineage markers (EPCAM, DCN, PTPRC-related genes) present.

label: GAS6/MYC/AXIN2-high
evidence: GAS6 (7%), MYC 0.66, KCNMA1 0.81, SESN3 0.93, PIK3R1, TCEA3, PKP2, SORL1, AXIN2 0.70, PTCH1 0.90, LGR6, AR 0.54, MLPH; mixed signals without lineage markers (EPCAM, DCN zero).

label: Endothelial cells
evidence: Specific endothelial genes: FLT1, PTPRB, PLVAP, ESM1, TIE1, EGFL7, CLDN5, NOTCH4, NOS3, CDH5, TEK, ROBO4, CLEC14A, MMRN2, PECAM1 0.72, KDR, CD34 (VWF not measured); PROX1/FLT4 present at low weight.

label: SRSF1/HOXB4-high
evidence: SRSF1 (13%, spec 0.86), HOXB4 1.00, SIGMAR1 1.00, TRAP1, DVL2, FDPS, KEAP1 1.00, TRAF2, PELP1, RNF43, DHCR7: many specific but unrelated genes without lineage markers, suggesting a clone- or batch-specific signal.

label: PRKCI-high tumor epithelium
evidence: PRKCI (20%, spec 1.00) with MECOM 0.38, SOX17, KLHL14, WT1, EPCAM at low weight; PRKCI, MECOM and ACTL6A all lie on 3q26, a common HGSOC amplicon, suggesting a clone-specific tumor program; PAX8 is not here.

label: Ovarian tumor epithelium (PAX8/MUC16)
evidence: MUC16 (10%, spec 1.00) and PAX8 (spec 1.00, its only factor) with ITGB4, KCNC3, NPR1, CELSR2, PTPRU, ERBB3, IGSF8, MUC5B; mesothelial markers (UPK3B, CALB2) and FOXJ1 are elsewhere.

label: CYP4B1/XPR1 tumor epithelium
evidence: CYP4B1 0.99, XPR1 1.00, ALPL 0.95, CBLB, ACPP, VTCN1, LRP2, ROS1, AQP5, with CCNE1 (0.63, its top factor) and KLHL14, EPCAM at low specificity: a distinct tumor epithelial program, possibly a CCNE1-amplified clone.

label: Mullerian tumor epithelium (SOX17/MECOM)
evidence: SOX17 (spec 0.78), MECOM 0.59, KIAA1324 1.00, LPAR3 1.00, WT1 (its top factor, 0.24), USP53, RSPO3, IGF1, APELA, NOX4 with epithelial EPCAM/CLDN7 at low weight; endothelial genes (PECAM1, CDH5) are in factor 44, and PAX8/MUC16 are in factor 47.

label: CTNNB1/CSNK1A1/FUS-high
evidence: CTNNB1 carries 21% of the weight and all of its expression (spec 1.00), alongside unrelated ubiquitous genes (CSNK1A1, FUS, CDC73, RAB11A, PRKAG1, DPP8). Wnt targets AXIN2, LGR5, LEF1 and TCF7 have zero weight, so it is a CTNNB1 transcript factor, not Wnt signaling.

label: TUBB-dominated (single gene)
evidence: TUBB alone carries 48% of the weight (spec 1.00) and LDHA adds 10% (spec 0.35); everything else is low-weight housekeeping (CALM3, RAN, EIF5A). There is no coherent second theme.

label: HNRNPH1/SYNCRIP/RBBP4-high
evidence: The genes carrying weight are ubiquitous RNA-binding and chromatin genes: HNRNPH1 16% (spec 1.00), YWHAZ 13% (spec 0.35), SYNCRIP, RBBP4, POLDIP2 and ZPR1 (spec 0.84-1.00). None of them marks a lineage or a known pathway.

label: THBS1-high fibroblast program
evidence: THBS1 dominates (43%, spec 1.00), together with fibroblast/elastic-matrix genes that are specific to this factor: ELN (1.00), MFAP5 (0.90), ACKR3, ADRA2A, FAT4, SYTL2, plus AEBP1, CTSK, SMOC2, TMEM119, FGF7, SLIT3 and ASPN. The core fibroblast markers DCN, LUM and PDGFRA sit in metagene 2 (zero weight here), so this reads as a fibroblast subprogram layered on that stroma.

label: ADNP/SSBP3/LAMP1-high
evidence: The weight is spread over ubiquitous chromatin, RNA-processing and lysosomal genes (LAMP1, TOP2B, ADNP 1.00, SUMO1, NUDT21, SMARCE1, SSBP3 1.00, IARS2, LARP4, CACUL1) with no lineage markers. There is no coherent theme.

label: SOX9/KCNK15/PART1-high
evidence: A diffuse factor (163 effective genes) whose specific genes are KCNK15 and PART1 (1.00), DACH1, TGFB2, FAM107A, PLCB1, FBLN5, IL11RA, HRH1, FST and LIN28B, with SOX9 at 0.55. It also carries vascular-type genes (MYL9, PODXL, HSPG2, BCAM, PLAT). Canonical epithelial (PAX8, WT1, EPCAM, CDH1, MUC16), stromal (DCN), endothelial (PECAM1) and sex-cord (FOXL2, NR5A1) markers all have zero weight.

label: EIF4A1-dominated (single gene)
evidence: EIF4A1 alone carries 50% of the weight (spec 1.00); the remaining genes are low-weight housekeeping genes (MMADHC, SEPTIN9, SNRPB, PAK1IP1).

label: FBL/IMPDH2-high (nucleolar)
evidence: FBL carries 26% (spec 1.00) and IMPDH2 11% (spec 0.36), with modest nucleolar/biosynthetic genes (NPM3, ESF1, TOP1MT, TKT, LRPPRC, SDAD1, WDR12). The specificities outside FBL are low, so this is mostly an FBL-driven factor with a weak ribosome-biogenesis flavor.

label: HSPA8-dominated (single gene)
evidence: HSPA8 carries 48% of the weight (spec 1.00); the remaining genes are low-weight housekeeping genes (EIF3C, GPBP1, CNOT1, FECH). The inducible heat-shock genes (HSPA1A/B, DNAJB1, HSPH1) are not on the panel, and no other heat-shock genes co-load, so this is not a stress program.

label: IGFBP2-high
evidence: IGFBP2 carries 26% of the weight (spec 1.00), followed by NREP, TWSG1, MEST and KCNK2 at moderate specificity; the rest are low-specificity housekeeping genes. Tumor markers (PAX8, EPCAM, MUC16) and DCN have zero weight, so the lineage cannot be assigned.

label: PTGES3/chaperonin-high
evidence: PTGES3 is the only highly specific gene (14%, spec 1.00). The rest is a low-specificity spread of chaperonin and MYC-target biosynthesis genes (HSPD1, HSPE1, TCP1, CCT5/7, NME1, C1QBP, RUVBL1, RAN), which overlap metagenes 67, 84 and 86.

label: SSB/GMPS/DPM1-high
evidence: Many ubiquitous genes are exclusive to this factor (SSB, GMPS, DPM1, NUTF2, SUMO4, GART, SIN3A, MAP1LC3A, LONP1, CCAR2, SF3B4, SCAF4, all spec ~0.9-1.0). Apart from a few purine-synthesis genes (GMPS, GART, PRPSAP1) they share no lineage or pathway.

label: AMOTL2/ANKRD33B/TIPARP-high
evidence: AMOTL2 (26%), ANKRD33B and TIPARP are exclusive to this factor, with BMP2K, EGFR, HPSE, IRS2, NEDD4L, JDP2, FGF9 and EPHA2 at moderate specificity. The canonical YAP targets CCN1 and CCN2 and the MAPK reporters DUSP6, ETV5, FOSL1 and EREG have zero weight, so no pathway call is supported.

label: AHCY-dominated, MYC/EPCAM-associated
evidence: AHCY carries 24% of the weight (spec 1.00), followed by low-specificity epithelial/MYC-associated genes (EIF4G1, EPCAM 0.13, HMGA1, MYC 0.20, PEG10, MTAP, ATIC, CDK4). PAX8 has zero weight. The only specific signal is the single gene AHCY.

label: RAC1/PEA15/RAP1A-high
evidence: RAC1 is the leading gene (17%, spec 0.84). Everything else is a diffuse (106 effective genes), low-specificity spread of ubiquitous signaling and cytoskeletal genes (PEA15, RAP1A, MSN, RHOA, ANXA2, CDC42, GRB2), with no lineage markers.

label: EIF4G1/PSMD3/TOP1-high
evidence: EIF4G1 (15%, spec 0.49), PSMD3, TOP1 and RANBP2 lead, with exclusive but unrelated ubiquitous genes (CASP8AP2, HSDL1, ANKRD40, STK11, G6PD). There is no coherent theme.

label: GOLPH3/NUMA1/HSF1-high
evidence: Unrelated ubiquitous genes are exclusive to this factor (NUMA1, AKAP8, UBE3A, PNPLA2, MED1, YY1AP1, FUBP3, ACVR1B, POLR2E, ZDHHC17, all spec 1.00), alongside GOLPH3, HSF1 and RAB5A. The HSF1 target genes do not co-load, so there is no pathway theme.

label: Chaperonin / heat shock (HSP60/HSP10)
evidence: A coherent chaperone set: HSPE1 (24%, spec 0.94), DNAJA1 (16%, 0.94), HSPD1 (16%, 0.56), CACYBP (0.85), CCT2, CCT6A, TCP1, CCT5, HSPA4, BAG3, PPID and TOMM34. The classic inducible HSP70 genes (HSPA1A/B, DNAJB1, HSPH1, HSP90AA1) are not on the panel, so it could not be checked whether this is acute heat shock or baseline chaperone load.

label: Actomyosin cytoskeleton (MYH9/MYL9)
evidence: MYH9 carries 28% (spec 1.00) and MYL9 16%, with actin-binding and focal-adhesion genes (ACTN1, ACTN4, PALLD, MYOF, MYO1C, CSRP1, IQGAP1, VCL, TUBB6 0.99, TGFB1I1, CAVIN3). Smooth-muscle markers (MYH11, CNN1) and fibroblast markers (DCN, POSTN) have zero weight, and ACTA2/TAGLN are not on the panel, so no lineage is assigned.

label: EMX2/LRRC47/NUAK2-high
evidence: EMX2 carries 14% (spec 1.00), alongside many unrelated ubiquitous genes that are also exclusive (LRRC47, NUAK2, RFX5, MYBBP1A, NMNAT1, ZSCAN16, TUBD1, RPAP1). Without other Mullerian or epithelial markers the factor has no coherent lineage.

label: SOST/DDX39B/LENG8-high
evidence: A diffuse factor (118 effective genes) made of many exclusive but unrelated ubiquitous nuclear genes (OGT, XPA, HDAC6, EZH1, TAF1, IRF3, MDM4, ULK1, snoRNA hosts SNHG8 and SNURF). Its only notable tissue gene is SOST (5%, spec 0.62), which does not fit an ovarian lineage.

label: HSPB1/PRRC2A/CHD3-high
evidence: HSPB1 (10%, spec 0.60), PRRC2A (0.92) and CHD3 lead, followed by unrelated exclusive genes (GIGYF1, SAT2, CFLAR, APPBP2, ALPK1, TRIM25, CDAN1, PPARA). There is no coherent stress or lineage signature.

label: TMEM123/BIRC2-high (possible 11q22 amplicon)
evidence: TMEM123 (32%) and BIRC2 (13%) are exclusive to this factor (spec 1.00), and YAP1 adds 1.9%. All three genes sit together in the 11q22.1-q22.2 amplicon recurrent in carcinomas, which suggests a copy-number-driven, clone-specific factor. BIRC3 and the 11q22 MMP genes have zero weight, so the amplicon call is tentative.

label: Immediate early / inflammatory stress response
evidence: CDKN1A (21%, spec 1.00), SOCS3 (19%, 0.96), NR4A1 (14%), EGR3, NR4A3, IL6 (0.74), CCL2, MAFF, ADAMTS4, PER1 and CH25H form a classic immediate-early/IL-6-STAT3 response, with stromal partners (CCL19, STEAP4, FGF10, HGF). FOS, JUN and EGR1 are not on the panel. The p53 targets MDM2 and GDF15 have no weight, so this is not a p53 program.

label: THSD4/C2orf88-high
evidence: Two genes take half the weight: THSD4 28% and C2orf88 23%, both spec 1.00. The rest are low-specificity epithelial and ubiquitous genes (TM9SF4, APOL2, EPCAM 0.05). A factor dominated by two such genes points to a probe- or gene-specific factor rather than a cell type.

label: SFPQ/RBMX/GUSB-high
evidence: SFPQ (24%), RBMX (16%) and GUSB (10%) take half the weight and are nearly exclusive to this factor (spec 0.89-1.00), together with INVS, TCF7L2 and TARDBP. The genes are unrelated and ubiquitous, consistent with a gene-specific factor.

label: Ovarian tumor epithelium
evidence: Epithelial genes lead: DHCR24 (0.96), CDH6 (0.65; a PAX8-linked HGSOC marker), CDH1 (0.54), BCAM, CLDN7, EPCAM, KLK6, KLK10, WWC1, SCNN1A, SOX9, ST14, OCLN, MAL, MSLN and PADI2. PAX8 and MUC16 are fully assigned to metagene 47 (zero weight here), so this is a secondary tumor-epithelial factor.

label: SOD1/HDAC2/PRPF8-high
evidence: Ubiquitous genes lead: SOD1 (16%, spec 0.78), HDAC2, PRPF8, EIF4EBP2, ECHS1 (0.93), TXNRD1, ATF2, CBR1. Only TXNRD1 and SOD1 hint at redox; NRF2 targets are not broadly co-loaded, so there is no coherent theme.

label: COL18A1/KRAS/ERGIC2-high
evidence: The factor mixes COL18A1, HSPG2 and FAT1 with KRAS (0.82), ERGIC2 (1.00), HEXIM1, DHDDS, TMEM185A, SLC30A7 and other exclusive housekeeping genes. KRAS and ERGIC2 are both 12p genes, but other 12p11-12 genes on the panel (CDKN1B, SOX5, PTHLH, PKP2, RECQL) have zero weight, so a 12p amplicon is not supported.

label: Ciliated epithelial cells
evidence: Motile-cilia genes are exclusive to this factor: FOXJ1, CFAP100, CFAP43, CFAP46, C20orf85, DRC1, DRC3, TEKT1, SPAG8, ZMYND10, DNAI1, DNAH2/7/9/10/11/12, plus RFX2, TPPP3 and MYB. PAX8 has zero weight. CAPS is not on the panel.

label: CTBP1/SNRNP200/USP10-high
evidence: The factor is made of ubiquitous nuclear and RNA-processing genes (CTBP1, SNRNP200, HSPA9, GPBP1L1, MTAP, CUL4A, USP10 1.00, PSIP1, EFTUD2) at moderate specificity. None of them marks a lineage or a specific pathway.

label: CBX3-dominated
evidence: CBX3 carries 28% of the weight (spec 1.00); the remaining genes are low-to-moderate-specificity housekeeping genes (AP2M1, HMGN3, SRI, KIF2A, FNTA, YY1, ZCCHC10).

label: Mesothelium
evidence: Mesothelial markers are specific here: PRG4 (1.00), BNC1 (1.00), CALB2 (0.75), UPK3B (0.64), PROCR (1.00), RGS4, CPA4, plus PDPN, CLDN1, DSC3 and complement genes (C4A/B, CFB). MSLN has zero weight (it sits in epithelial factors 76/41/45), WT1 is low, and DCN has zero weight. The factor is diffuse (282 effective genes) and its usage share is low.

label: ECPAS/CREB1/CENPB-high
evidence: Unrelated ubiquitous genes are exclusive to this factor (ECPAS, CREB1, CENPB, CDC34, ZER1, NOMO3, EMSY, CASP7, KIAA2013), alongside EIF3A, POLR2C and CFDP1. There is no coherent theme.

label: MYC-target biosynthesis / chaperonins
evidence: A diffuse (98 effective genes), low-specificity set of MYC-target and biosynthetic genes: HSPD1, RAN, HMGA1, NME1 (0.56), HSPA9, CCT3/5, TKT, RUVBL1, C1QBP, NOLC1, AAMP, EIF4EBP1. MYC itself is low (spec 0.05), and the cell-cycle markers MKI67/TOP2A sit in metagene 19.

label: PLXNB2/IL1R1-high
evidence: PLXNB2 (26%) and IL1R1 (15%) are both exclusive to this factor (spec 1.00) and take 41% of the weight. The rest are moderate-specificity genes (CSF1, TPCN1, INPPL1, IGF2R, PON2). Two unrelated genes dominating points to a gene-specific factor rather than a pathway.

label: XRCC6/NOLC1 ribosome biogenesis
evidence: XRCC6 (0.89), NOLC1 (0.68), PSMD4 (0.87) and RPF1 (0.70) are the specific genes, with nucleolar and biosynthetic genes (GNL2, GTPBP4, NOP2, LYAR, DDX27, CCT5/7, ATIC). This is MYC-target/ribosome-biogenesis-like, but the theme is diffuse.

label: XPO1/PDCD6/GCN1-high
evidence: Many unrelated ubiquitous genes are exclusive to this factor (PDCD6, GCN1, CUL5, BSDC1, ZBTB10, RAD54L2, RHBDD1, GTPBP10, CLN5, MUTYH, MAGI3), with XPO1 leading at 9%. There is no lineage or pathway theme.

label: ATF4-dominated
evidence: ATF4 carries 22% of the weight (spec 1.00), but its canonical targets have zero weight (DDIT3, TRIB3, SLC7A11, PHGDH, VEGFA, ATF3) or are not on the panel (ASNS, CHAC1). This is therefore an ATF4-transcript factor, not an integrated stress response.

label: CSNK2B/RANBP9/AKT2-high
evidence: A diffuse factor (92 effective genes) of exclusive but unrelated ubiquitous signaling and nuclear genes (RANBP9, AKT2, PPP2R1A, BTAF1, SRCAP, TERF2, MAPK7, MAPK14, TAB1, TICAM1). There is no coherent theme.

label: DNA replication (S phase)
evidence: Replication-licensing and S-phase genes: MCM3/4/5/6/7 (0.62-0.95), PCNA, DHFR, RRM1, DNMT1, CDK2, RFC5, WDHD1, CHEK1, BARD1, BRCA2, RAD51, HELLS, UHRF1, CDC6, plus DEK and SMC1A/3. The G2/M markers MKI67 and TOP2A have zero weight (they sit in metagene 19), so this is the S-phase arm.

label: Tumor epithelium (FOLR1/MUC1/MAL2)
evidence: MAL2 (17%), MUC1, FOLR1 (an HGSOC marker), IL15 and OXSM are exclusive (spec 1.00), with NOTCH2 (0.82), PEG10, ATP6V1B1, EPHA1, ID4, TRPM2 and CCL28. PAX8, EPCAM, CDH1 and MSLN are carried by other epithelial factors (zero weight here), so this is a secondary tumor-epithelial program.

label: ZNF512/NCOR1/SEMA4C-high
evidence: A diffuse factor (163 effective genes) of exclusive but unrelated ubiquitous genes (ZNF512, CRYZL1, DNMT3A, BICRAL, ZSCAN26, DNAJC17, INO80D, IRGQ, NAA16). There is no lineage or pathway signal.

label: CCT3/PHB2/CCDC6-high
evidence: CCT3 (20%, spec 0.85) and PHB2 (15%, spec 0.41) lead, followed by unrelated genes (CCDC6, HIPK2, NOC3L 1.00, FOXO3, SIMC1). The other chaperonin subunits are not co-loaded, unlike metagene 67.

label: ER protein folding (PDI/calnexin)
evidence: ER-lumen folding genes: PDIA3 (1.00), PDIA4 (0.88), HYOU1 (0.88), P4HB, CANX, SDF2L1 (0.65), ATP2A2, NCSTN, ZMPSTE24, GANAB and NFE2L1. HSPA5, CALR, HSP90B1 and MANF are not on the panel, and XBP1 has low specificity (0.04), so it could not be checked whether this is active UPR or baseline ER load.

label: ANKRD13A/HEXA/MAPK1-high
evidence: Unrelated genes are exclusive here (ANKRD13A, MARK2, TBL2, TMEM9B, SPPL2A, CHFR, WDR55, CYP20A1), with lysosomal HEXA/HEXB and TFE3 and trace myeloid genes (TLR6, CLEC4A, RNASE3) at very low weight. Macrophage markers (CD68, CD163, CD14, CSF1R, AIF1) have zero weight.

label: PPFIA1/MTREX/TRIM27-high
evidence: A diffuse factor of exclusive but unrelated ubiquitous genes (PPFIA1, MTREX, TRIM27, ELMOD2, SMARCAD1, KMT2D, PIKFYVE, TBCK). FKBP11 is present, but the plasma-cell markers MZB1, CD79A and XBP1 have zero weight.

label: HNRNPUL1/CLTC/NONO-high
evidence: The genes are ubiquitous nuclear and trafficking genes (HNRNPUL1, CLTC, NONO, IPO7, SP3, ROCK1, EP300, CLPX, RAD50, PEPD 0.94) at moderate specificity. There is no coherent theme.

label: CTNND1/POGZ/IGF1R-high
evidence: Several unrelated genes are exclusive to this factor (POGZ, IGF1R, FGFR2, CAMSAP2, PBXIP1, PDE4DIP, THRA, SMARCAL1, CARF, HEATR6, CASP9, FOXP4), with CTNND1 at 0.97. They are long or regulatory genes with no shared pathway or lineage.

label: SF3B1/CREBBP/SMARCA2-high
evidence: Large chromatin and RNA-processing genes are exclusive or nearly so (SF3B1 0.80, CREBBP 0.95, SMARCA2 1.00, TDRD3, MTR, LATS1, UBR3, ERCC6, PHF8, DICER1), together with NR1H3, CAT and ORAI3. The set is functionally heterogeneous, so there is no coherent theme.
